question: A line segment is of length 5 cm 7 mm. Another line segment of length 9 cm 6 mm is joined to it in the same direction. The length of the combined line segment is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert everything to **mm**: 5 cm 7 mm = 57 mm and 9 cm 6 mm = 96 mm.

Total length = 57 mm + 96 mm = 153 mm.

Convert back: 153 mm = 150 mm + 3 mm = 15 cm 3 mm.

**∴ The correct answer is 15 cm 3 mm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of **first segment** = 5 cm 7 mm

Length of **second segment** = 9 cm 6 mm

**Formula Used:**

1 cm = 10 mm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ed7a82bfe6c9e88a2eec1aa1f525fb525ec15791d3a0181883ebc47bc64b932.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Length = (5 cm 7 mm) + (9 cm 6 mm)

⇒ Add **cm** parts: 5 cm + 9 cm = 14 cm

⇒ Add **mm** parts: 7 mm + 6 mm = 13 mm

⇒ Since 10 mm = 1 cm, 13 mm = 1 cm 3 mm

⇒ Total = 14 cm + 1 cm 3 mm

⇒ Total = 15 cm 3 mm

**∴ The correct answer is 15 cm 3 mm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion

Always ensure all measurements are in the **same unit** before performing addition or subtraction. Use the standard 1 cm = 10 mm ratio.

Metric System Prefixes

Length is measured in **meters (m)**. 1 m = 100 cm = 1000 mm. For smaller precision, **millimeters (mm)** are used.</p
